market_summary: U.S. equities enter June 16, 2026 with a risk-on tone after a sharp three-day S&P 500 rebound driven by U.S.-Iran relief, lower oil, lower yields, and easing volatility. The setup favors selective liquid long ideas in AI/chips and durable catalyst names, but entry quality is mixed because many leaders already gapped hard and the Fed decision plus triple-witching risk can amplify reversals.

market_thesis.primary_swing_theory: Over the next 2-10 trading days, relief from energy/geopolitical stress should keep buyers engaged in liquid growth and industrial/defense-adjacent names if oil stays contained, VIX remains near the mid-teens, and indexes hold the post-relief breakout range.
drivers: U.S.-Iran/Strait of Hormuz relief lowering oil and volatility
Lower Treasury yields supporting growth and chip multiples
AI infrastructure and defense-production catalysts in individual large caps
Fed decision and options-expiration positioning creating intraday volatility
what_would_change_my_mind: VIX reclaims the high teens with broad index weakness
Oil reverses sharply higher on renewed Strait of Hormuz risk
The S&P 500 loses the prior relief-rally breakout and breadth deteriorates
Fed communication reprices yields higher and pressures growth leadership
market_thesis.crowding_assessment: medium: the relief rally is obvious and several AI/storage names are extended, so entries need intraday confirmation rather than open-market chasing.

QCOM.execution_condition: Buy only if QCOM is trading between 224.00 and 229.50, holding above VWAP, and semiconductor ETFs are not rolling over.
